purpose: Cross-check five disputed Agno River Basin fish-name strings against the California Academy of Sciences Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes, then compare the authority's current name statuses with the article and released count-file spellings.

independentAuthority.name: Eschmeyer's Catalog of Fishes
independentAuthority.publisher: California Academy of Sciences, Institute for Biodiversity Science and Sustainability
independentAuthority.scope: Independent nomenclatural/current-name authority for fishes; this is not specimen-level identification evidence, a locality source, or an occurrence dataset.
independentAuthority.license: No item-specific open license for republication of catalog text was identified. The review records concise attributed status summaries and links; it does not reproduce catalog text blocks.

comparativeEvidence.comparisonRule: Keep each released-data string verbatim and preserve article table/figure differences. A taxonomic authority can support a spelling, authorship, or synonym proposal; it cannot validate the survey's specimen identification or rewrite the source row.

nameDecisions.authorityStatus: Synonym of Pseudogobius poicilosoma (Bleeker, 1849), in the Catalog's current status field; the catalog cites Larson & Hammer (2021) and Parenti (2021) for this treatment.
nameDecisions.articleUse: The article uses Pseudogobius javanicus in its species list, Table 3, Figure 2 caption and discussion; Table 3 assigns it to ARB2 and ARB6.
nameDecisions.crosscheckResult: The current synonym treatment agrees with the earlier Catalogue of Life XR synonym proposal. The nomenclatural conflict is resolved in favor of a synonym mapping for research crosswalk purposes.
nameDecisions.disposition: Retain the original label and its original station-count cells. Pseudogobius poicilosoma is a candidate current-name mapping only; without voucher or author identification review, do not publish a revised species occurrence or claim that the sampled specimens have been reidentified.

nameDecisions.articleUse: The released dataset has the spelling mozambicus; the article's abstract, Table 3, Figure 2 caption and results use mossambicus.
nameDecisions.crosscheckResult: The authority supports the article spelling as the accepted name and indicates that the dataset spelling is a likely typographic variant in this source pair.
nameDecisions.disposition: Store a corrected-name proposal linked to the verbatim dataset label; preserve original CSV bytes and count values. This does not independently identify the specimens or approve a distribution claim.

nameDecisions.articleUse: The article spells the name Poecilia reticulata in Table 3 and Figure 2 and Poecilla reticulata in one prose passage; the dataset uses Poecilla reticulata.
nameDecisions.crosscheckResult: Catalog spelling agrees with the article table/figure and supports a likely source typographical correction from Poecilla to Poecilia.
nameDecisions.disposition: Retain the verbatim label and count cell; record Poecilia reticulata as a proposed current spelling. No specimen-level identity or app occurrence was approved.

nameDecisions.articleUse: The article Figure 2 caption uses Poecilia sphenops; its Table 3 and prose use Poecilla sphenops, while Table 3 prints Valenciennes, 1864.
nameDecisions.crosscheckResult: The authority supports the genus spelling Poecilia and authorship/year Valenciennes, 1846; the source article is internally inconsistent.
nameDecisions.disposition: Record Poecilia sphenops (Valenciennes, 1846) as a proposed nomenclatural normalization with the table/figure discrepancy attached. Preserve source strings and original count; specimen identity remains unverified.

nameDecisions.articleUse: The article Table 3 prints the genus/species with the misspelled author and year “Linnaues, 1975”; its abstract/table species name and Figure 2 use Cyprinus carpio without that authority error.
nameDecisions.crosscheckResult: The authority supports Linnaeus, 1758 as the nomenclatural authorship/year and confirms the spelling Cyprinus carpio.
nameDecisions.disposition: Record the corrected authorship as a source-linked nomenclatural proposal. Keep the original article and count label unchanged; this does not validate the source's carp specimen identification.

limitations: Catalog current-name and synonym status does not establish that the authors correctly identified each fish specimen.
A corrected spelling or authority is a normalization proposal, not an edit to the deposited data or paper.
Three genus-only source rows remain unresolved, and other binomial labels were not independently re-reviewed in this follow-up.
Season/date mapping, ARB5 locality, and exact station-to-reach identity remain unresolved; no regional or basin-wide completeness follows from the study.
Historical sampled counts do not establish present-day presence, catchability, diet, bait suitability, access, legal status, or safety.
nextAction: Keep the five corrected names as research-only linked proposals. Seek author/publisher clarification for the season/date conflict and ARB5 municipality/reach conflict before preparing a historical station assertion batch; no inquiry was sent. Continue the wider freshwater and regional source queue in parallel.
